answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. A oasis of per-task receipts records who did what, and the whisper of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the mirror of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
